topic.label: Knowledge
topic.desc: Knowledge management for people and agents: ontologies and taxonomies, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, metadata, curation and quality, retrieval and question answering, documentation and sharing. Extends the base Knowledge topic, which held only Knowledge Graph.

concepts: Choosing the classes, relations and naming rules a body of knowledge uses, and keeping them consistent as they grow.
Pulling entities, relations and claims out of documents, tables and conversations, with the source span for each.
Deciding that two records are the same thing, merging them safely and linking mentions to canonical identifiers.
Describing knowledge with where it came from, when, under what licence and how much it can be trusted.
Keeping a knowledge base correct: review queues, contradiction checks, staleness, deprecation and change history.
Finding and using knowledge to answer questions: indexing, chunking, hybrid search, reranking and answers that cite their sources.
Asking questions of a graph: path and pattern queries, inference rules and checks for consistency.
Turning what is known into pages people use: wikis, notes, glossaries, onboarding material and clear handoffs.
skills: Proposes classes, properties and relations for a domain from sample documents and lists the competency questions the model must answer.
Builds a category tree with clear inclusion rules and checks that every item fits exactly one place or says why it fits several.
Writes identifier and label rules for concepts and tests them against existing names to find clashes.
Extracts entities and relations from text with the exact source sentence and a confidence for each.
Maps columns of a table to graph nodes and edges, with a mapping file and a sample of the resulting triples.
Lists the factual claims a document makes in separate sentences, each with its source location and whether it is checkable.
Finds likely duplicate records with similarity scores and shows the fields that agree and disagree.
Plans a merge of two records, decides which field wins and records enough to undo the merge later.
Links mentions to canonical identifiers in an external registry and flags ambiguous mentions for a person to decide.
Adds source, date, author and licence to each item and reports items whose origin cannot be shown.
Designs a small required metadata schema, with controlled values and which fields are mandatory, and validates a sample.
Records when each fact was last confirmed, sets a review interval by how fast it changes and lists items past due.
Finds statements in a knowledge base that cannot both be true and shows both sources side by side.
Orders items for human review by risk and use, tracks decisions and reports review backlog.
Plans how a fact or page is retired: redirect, replacement, notice and what depends on it.
Chooses how documents are split and indexed so passages keep their meaning, and measures retrieval on sample questions.
Tunes keyword and vector search weights and reranking against a labelled question set and reports the gain.
Answers a question from retrieved passages, cites the passage behind each statement and says when the sources do not answer it.
Writes a path or pattern query for a question about the graph and explains what each clause matches.
Writes rules that derive new facts from existing ones and tests each rule for unwanted conclusions.
Runs constraint checks for missing required links, cycles and impossible values and lists violating nodes.
Collects terms used across documents, writes one plain definition for each and flags terms used in conflicting senses.
Builds a reading path for a newcomer that orders pages by what they need first and marks the essential ones.
Writes a handoff note with current state, decisions made, open questions and where the supporting files are.
